'''Cooling vanes''' were [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] components utilized on [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. The cooling vanes were located in each of the fighter's [[4L4 fusial thrust engine/Legends|4L4 fusial thrust engine]]. The microporous blades cooled and compressed [[Gas/Legends|gasses]] to dissipate the high heat generated by the engine.<ref name="SWS" />
